People: Alexander Pope (author, Wikidata Q164047), died 1744; George Gilfillan (notes, Wikidata Q5539710), died 1878. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Pope, Alexander, 1688-1744; Gilfillan, George, 1813-1878 [Commentator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The poetical works of Alexander Pope, esq.; to which is prefixed the life of the author, Philadelphia, J.J. Woodward, 1839, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/poeticalworksofa04pope. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 93%, 76%, 43% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of George Gilfillan, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
